categories.title: Animal Head
categories.info:
After discovering a matching pair of Animal Heads, they can be awakened using the [Animal Flute](https://mapgenie.io/animal-well/maps/world?locationIds=356984). You'll know an Animal Head has been "found" when its location is marked by a white pixel on the map.

Use Animal Heads to fast travel around the map.

categories.title: Candle
categories.info:
Candles require a Match to be lit. There are nine total of both. Unlike Matches, Candles cannot be picked up. If you don't have a Match on hand, you'll need to mark the spot on your map and return later.

To check your progress in-game, find the [Candle Tracker](https://mapgenie.io/animal-well/maps/world?locationIds=357356).
